message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: public official (尹某) receiving cash and gift cards from people in exchange for favor in project bidding and contracting. This is bribery (受贿). Also possibly embezzlement? He "将该款占为己有" after receiving cash as bribe. That's still bribery. Also "提供发票" maybe false invoice? He gave 8万元发票 to Wang to "solve" something, maybe facilitating bribery? Could be "行贿" by Wang, but we only list crimes of the defendant (尹某). He accepted bribes: multiple instances. Also "收受现金" is "受贿罪". Also "收受购物卡" is also bribery. Also "收受代缴住院费名义的现金" also bribery. Also "将受贿款上缴纪委廉政账户" maybe not a crime, but the act of returning after being discovered is not a crime. So the crimes:受贿罪 (accepting bribes). Possibly also "挪用公款" if he used public funds? Not indicated. So just "受贿罪". Could also be "滥用职权" but not indicated. So answer: [受贿罪]<eoa>. Use format: [受贿罪]<eoa>.
